# Mohammed Sarfaraz Uddin Nasser

> Frontend Developer & Computer Science Engineering student based in Hyderabad, India. Interactive macOS desktop portfolio built with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.

Mohammed Sarfaraz Uddin Nasser (Sarfaraz) is an ambitious Frontend Developer and 3rd-year Computer Science Engineering student at ISL Engineering College (2024–2028). He specializes in React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, and Tailwind CSS. He builds production client-facing web applications, modern responsive UI interfaces, and won 2nd Place (₹10,000 cash prize) at the national-level Hack4SDG hackathon organized by AIESEC and IIT Hyderabad.

## Key Projects

- [SafeSpeak](https://spih-146.vercel.app/): Anonymous multilingual peer-support platform with real-time conversations and language-based matching, built in 24 hours at SPEC Industry Hack 2026.
- [SafeSpeak Source Code](https://github.com/MohammedSarfaraz-droid/SafeSpeak): Open-source repository for SafeSpeak built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and Firebase.
- [LumeNoor](https://lumenoor.com/): Agency landing page presenting web-development services through a polished, conversion-focused interface.
- [LumeNoor Source Code](https://github.com/MohammedSarfaraz-droid/LumeNoor): Open-source GitHub repository for LumeNoor.
- [Nick Contractor](https://www.nickcontractor.com/): Production marketing website for general contracting business, delivered at AM Software Solutions.
- [Gutama Roofing](https://www.gutamaroofingnj.com/): Brand-aligned commercial and residential roofing company website in New Jersey.
- [Topcoat LLC](https://www.topcoat-llc.com/): Clean, high-conversion painting contractor website.
